note: Compliance thresholds referenced by name in policies/rules.rego. `value: null` means there's no single correct figure to default to -- see `citation` for why, and set it from your own policy before enforcing.

material_nonpublic_info_flag_required.citation: Baseline expectation under insider-trading/MNPI surveillance regimes -- confirm against the firm's information barrier policy.

human_review_confirmed.citation: Structural requirement, not a regulatory figure -- every guardrail needs an explicit human-review signal before allowing a decision through.
